full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photographic montage shows two small standing figures near the far opening of a vast circular passage. The viewer looks through the dark interior toward a pale, clouded sky. The tunnel wall curves in from every edge of the upper frame, forming a broad charcoal ring around the nearly round opening. Its surface is densely mottled with soft, directional grain; the top and sides fall almost to black, while the lower right inner wall picks up a little gray light. The nearer ground fills the bottom quarter with rough, flat, dusty texture and a faint horizontal seam. Near the opening, a taller dark figure stands slightly right of center, seen from behind in a long straight coat and narrow trousers. A shorter figure stands to the left in a flared dark coat. Both remain tiny against the immense arch, and their dark silhouettes are sharply legible without facial detail. Beyond them, the empty sky is layered in soft grays, with a brighter hazy patch just left of center and a low distant tonal band. The photograph has a quiet, staged surrealism: the passage appears ordinary in texture yet implausibly large, and the people seem held at the threshold of an undefined space. Light comes from the opening and fades quickly along the textured interior, making the circular negative space the strongest compositional shape. The grayscale range is restrained, with deep blacks, silvery middle tones, and a pale center. Sparse placement, monumental scale contrast, and the smooth curve against gritty ground create a still, contemplative rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影拼贴呈现两个小小站立人影，位于巨大圆形通道的远端出口附近。视线从深暗内部望向苍白、多云的天空。隧道壁从画幅上部各边弯入，在近乎圆形的出口周围形成宽阔的炭黑色环。表面布满柔和、带方向性的颗粒斑驳；顶部与两侧几乎沉入黑色，内壁右下只接到少量灰光。近处地面占下四分之一，呈粗糙、平坦、尘土般的肌理，横向接缝隐约可见。靠近出口处，一个较高的深色人影立在中心稍右，背向观者，穿着笔直长外套和窄裤。左侧另有一个较矮人影，披着下摆外展的深色外衣。两者相对于巨大的拱口都很小，深色剪影清楚可辨，面部没有细节。人物后方是层叠柔灰的空天空，中央偏左有较亮的朦胧光斑，低处横着一道远方色带。照片具有安静而经过布置的超现实感：通道肌理看似寻常，尺度却大得难以置信，人物仿佛停在未定义空间的门槛。光从出口进入，并沿有纹理的内部迅速衰减，使圆形留白成为最强的构图形状。灰阶克制，包含深黑、银灰中间调与苍白中心。稀疏的人影、宏大的尺度对比，以及光滑弧线和粗粝地面之间的关系，形成静止而沉思的节奏。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome photographic montage relies on restrained grayscale and an unusually large field of dark negative space. A broad curved boundary encloses a pale, softly clouded center, while fine directional grain and mottled shading make the surrounding surface tangible. Edges alternate between clean silhouette and gently dissolving tone; small near-black accents stay crisp against the bright zone. Light appears to enter from a single distant opening and falls off quickly into charcoal shadow. A rough, low horizontal plane steadies the composition beneath the sweeping curve. Scale is established by a few tiny upright marks rather than detailed rendering. The scene is sparse and deliberately staged, with broad tonal masses, visible photographic grain, and generous intervals of emptiness giving it a quiet surreal rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 单色摄影拼贴依靠克制的灰阶和异常宽阔的深暗负空间。宽大的弧形边界围住苍白、带柔云的中央区域；细密的方向性颗粒和斑驳阴影让外围表面具有触感。边缘在干净剪影与缓缓消散的灰调之间交替，少量近黑色重音在明亮区域前保持清晰。光仿佛从远处单一开口进入，迅速衰减为炭灰阴影。低处粗糙的水平色面稳住上方扫过的曲线。尺度由几个极小的竖向笔形建立，无需精密刻画。画面稀疏、布置感明确，宽阔明暗块、可见摄影颗粒及充足空隙共同形成安静而超现实的节奏。
theme_en: Two small figures at the opening of a vast circular tunnel
theme_zh: 巨大圆形隧道出口前的两个小小人影
name: Gilbert Garcin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
